package validators

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// WorkspaceFile represents a file in workspace.
type WorkspaceFile = answeruc.WorkspaceFile

type ValidationResult = answeruc.ValidationResult

type ValidationError = answeruc.ValidationError

type ValidatorClient = answeruc.ValidatorClient

// Factory creates validator clients.
type Factory struct {
	natsConn          *natsgo.Conn
	htmlValidatorURL  string
	htmlSubject       string
	cssSubject        string
	phpValidatorURL   string
	nodeValidatorURL  string
	reactValidatorURL string
}

// NewFactory creates a new validator factory.
func NewFactory(natsConn *natsgo.Conn, htmlValidatorURL, htmlSubject, cssSubject, phpValidatorURL, nodeValidatorURL, reactValidatorURL string) *Factory {
	return &Factory{
		natsConn:          natsConn,
		htmlValidatorURL:  htmlValidatorURL,
		htmlSubject:       htmlSubject,
		cssSubject:        cssSubject,
		phpValidatorURL:   phpValidatorURL,
		nodeValidatorURL:  nodeValidatorURL,
		reactValidatorURL: reactValidatorURL,
	}
}

// GetValidator returns validator for code structure type.
func (f *Factory) GetValidator(codeStructureTypeCode string) ValidatorClient {
	switch normalizeCodeStructureTypeCode(codeStructureTypeCode) {
	case "html":
		return &HTMLValidator{
			conn:    f.natsConn,
			subject: f.htmlSubject,
			baseURL: f.htmlValidatorURL,
		}
	case "css", "scss", "acss", "sass":
		return &CSSValidator{conn: f.natsConn, subject: f.cssSubject}
	case "php":
		return NewPHPValidator(f.phpValidatorURL)
	case "node", "nodejs", "javascript", "typescript":
		return &NodeValidator{baseURL: f.nodeValidatorURL}
	case "react", "reactjs":
		return &ReactValidator{baseURL: f.reactValidatorURL}
	default:
		return nil
	}
}

func normalizeCodeStructureTypeCode(raw string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}

	upper := strings.ToUpper(trimmed)
	switch upper {
	case "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT":
		return "html"
	case "CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET":
		return "css"
	case "PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return "php"
	case "REACT_COMPONENT_BASIC":
		return "react"
	case "NEXTJS_BASIC":
		return "react"
	case "EXPRESSJS_BASIC":
		return "nodejs"
	case "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC":
		return "javascript"
	case "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return "javascript"
	case "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC":
		return "typescript"
	case "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return "typescript"
	case "NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return "nodejs"
	}

	lower := strings.ToLower(trimmed)
	switch lower {
	case "task-html":
		return "html"
	case "task-react":
		return "react"
	default:
		return lower
	}
}

// HTMLValidator validates HTML.
type HTMLValidator struct {
	conn    *natsgo.Conn
	subject string
	baseURL string
}

func (v *HTMLValidator) ValidateAll(ctx context.Context, taskID string, files []WorkspaceFile) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	var htmlPath string
	var htmlContent string
	for _, file := range files {
		if isHTMLFilePath(file.Path) {
			htmlPath = file.Path
			htmlContent = file.Content
			break
		}
	}
	if htmlContent == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{Valid: false, Errors: []ValidationError{
			{Code: "NO_HTML_FILE", Message: "No HTML file found"},
		}}, nil
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(v.baseURL) != "" {
		return v.validateOverHTTP(ctx, taskID, htmlPath, htmlContent)
	}
	if v.conn == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator unavailable: nats connection is nil")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(v.subject) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator unavailable: subject is empty")
	}

	req := map[string]interface{}{
		"taskId": taskID,
		"code":   htmlContent,
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(req)

	msg, err := v.conn.RequestWithContext(ctx, v.subject, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator request unavailable")
	}
	return decodeHTMLValidationResponse(msg.Data, "")
}

func (v *HTMLValidator) validateOverHTTP(ctx context.Context, taskID, htmlPath, htmlContent string) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	reqPayload := map[string]any{
		"taskId": taskID,
		"code":   htmlContent,
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(reqPayload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator request encoding failed")
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(v.baseURL, "/")+"/validate", bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator request unavailable")
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator request unavailable")
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator response unavailable")
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator returned a technical error")
	}
	return decodeHTMLValidationResponse(body, htmlPath)
}

func decodeHTMLValidationResponse(data []byte, fallbackPath string) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	var response struct {
		IsValid *bool           `json:"isValid"`
		Errors  json.RawMessage `json:"errors"`
		Error   json.RawMessage `json:"error"`
	}
	protocolError := func() (*ValidationResult, error) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("html validator returned an invalid response")
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &response) != nil || response.IsValid == nil || len(response.Error) != 0 ||
		len(response.Errors) == 0 || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(response.Errors), []byte("null")) {
		return protocolError()
	}
	var issues []struct {
		Code    string  `json:"code"`
		Message *string `json:"message"`
		Path    string  `json:"path"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(response.Errors, &issues) != nil || (*response.IsValid && len(issues) != 0) {
		return protocolError()
	}
	result := &ValidationResult{Valid: *response.IsValid, Errors: []ValidationError{}}
	for _, item := range issues {
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.Code) == "" || item.Message == nil {
			return protocolError()
		}
		file := item.Path
		if fallbackPath != "" {
			file = strings.TrimSpace(file)
			if file == "" {
				file = fallbackPath
			}
		}
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    item.Code,
			Message: *item.Message,
			File:    file,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

// CSSValidator validates CSS.
type CSSValidator struct {
	conn    *natsgo.Conn
	subject string
}

func (v *CSSValidator) ValidateAll(ctx context.Context, taskID string, files []WorkspaceFile) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	if v.conn == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator unavailable: nats connection is nil")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(v.subject) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator unavailable: subject is empty")
	}
	var stylesheets []WorkspaceFile
	for _, file := range files {
		path := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(file.Path))
		if strings.HasSuffix(path, ".sass") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator does not support indented Sass")
		}
		if cssFileLanguage(path) != "" {
			stylesheets = append(stylesheets, file)
		}
	}
	if len(stylesheets) == 0 {
		return &ValidationResult{Valid: false, Errors: []ValidationError{{Code: "NO_CSS_FILE", Message: "No CSS file found"}}}, nil
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	result := &ValidationResult{Valid: true, Errors: []ValidationError{}}
	for _, file := range stylesheets {
		request := map[string]any{
			"language": cssFileLanguage(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(file.Path))),
			"code":     file.Content,
			"rules":    map[string]any{"rules": []any{}},
			"locale":   "en",
			"meta":     map[string]string{"taskId": taskID, "path": file.Path},
		}
		data, err := json.Marshal(request)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator request encoding failed")
		}
		message, err := v.conn.RequestWithContext(ctx, v.subject, data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator request unavailable")
		}
		fileResult, err := decodeCSSValidationResponse(message.Data, file.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result.Valid = result.Valid && fileResult.Valid
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, fileResult.Errors...)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func cssFileLanguage(path string) string {
	for _, language := range []string{"css", "scss", "acss"} {
		if strings.HasSuffix(path, "."+language) {
			return language
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func decodeCSSValidationResponse(data []byte, filePath string) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	var response struct {
		IsValid *bool           `json:"isValid"`
		Errors  json.RawMessage `json:"errors"`
	}
	protocolError := func() (*ValidationResult, error) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator returned an invalid response")
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &response) != nil || response.IsValid == nil ||
		len(response.Errors) == 0 || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(response.Errors), []byte("null")) {
		return protocolError()
	}
	var errors []struct {
		Code     string `json:"code"`
		Message  string `json:"message"`
		Position *struct {
			Line   *int `json:"line"`
			Column *int `json:"column"`
		} `json:"position"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(response.Errors, &errors) != nil || (*response.IsValid && len(errors) != 0) || (!*response.IsValid && len(errors) == 0) {
		return protocolError()
	}
	result := &ValidationResult{Valid: *response.IsValid, Errors: []ValidationError{}}
	for _, item := range errors {
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.Code) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(item.Message) == "" {
			return protocolError()
		}
		// The provider conflates source syntax and internal failures under this
		// code. Preserve that uncertainty instead of recording a learner failure.
		if item.Code == "internal.compiler_error" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("css validator compilation unavailable")
		}
		// Only the provider-owned I18nMessageKey semantic codes may cross this
		// boundary. Arbitrary codes and localized/provider-authored text can
		// contain source or private diagnostic details.
		switch item.Code {
		case "selector.not_found", "selector.not_found_in_media", "declaration.not_found",
			"declaration.value_mismatch", "declaration.not_allowed_value", "occurrence.min",
			"occurrence.max", "media.not_found":
		default:
			return protocolError()
		}
		mapped := ValidationError{Code: item.Code, Message: "Stylesheet validation failed", File: filePath}
		if item.Position != nil {
			if item.Position.Line != nil {
				mapped.Line = *item.Position.Line
			}
			if item.Position.Column != nil {
				mapped.Column = *item.Position.Column
			}
		}
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, mapped)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func isHTMLFilePath(path string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(path))
	return strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".html") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".htm")
}

// NodeValidator validates Node.js.
type NodeValidator struct {
	baseURL string
}

func (v *NodeValidator) ValidateAll(ctx context.Context, taskID string, files []WorkspaceFile) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	if v.baseURL == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("node validator url is empty")
	}
	if len(files) == 0 {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid: false,
			Errors: []ValidationError{
				{Code: "NO_SOURCE_FILES", Message: "No source files found"},
			},
		}, nil
	}
	language := "ts"
	entrypoint, sourceContent := pickPrimarySource(files)
	if entrypoint == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid: false,
			Errors: []ValidationError{
				{Code: "NO_SOURCE_FILE", Message: "No JavaScript or TypeScript source file found"},
			},
		}, nil
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(sourceContent) == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid: false,
			Errors: []ValidationError{
				{Code: "EMPTY_SOURCE_FILE", Message: fmt.Sprintf("Source file is empty: %s", entrypoint), File: entrypoint},
			},
		}, nil
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(entrypoint, ".js") || strings.HasSuffix(entrypoint, ".jsx") {
		language = "js"
	}

	reqPayload := map[string]any{
		"language":  language,
		"framework": "none",
		"mode": map[string]bool{
			"static":    true,
			"structure": false,
			"runtime":   false,
		},
		"taskMeta": map[string]string{
			"taskId": taskID,
		},
		"code": map[string]any{
			"files":      files,
			"entrypoint": entrypoint,
		},
		"rules": map[string]any{},
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(reqPayload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, v.baseURL+"/api/v1/validate-node", bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("node validator error: status=%d body=%s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	var decoded struct {
		OK     bool  `json:"ok"`
		Valid  *bool `json:"valid,omitempty"`
		Errors []struct {
			Code     string `json:"code"`
			Message  string `json:"message"`
			Location struct {
				File   string `json:"file"`
				Line   int    `json:"line"`
				Column int    `json:"column"`
			} `json:"location"`
		} `json:"errors"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &decoded); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	isValid := decoded.OK
	if decoded.Valid != nil {
		isValid = *decoded.Valid
	}

	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0, len(decoded.Errors))
	for _, item := range decoded.Errors {
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    item.Code,
			Message: item.Message,
			File:    item.Location.File,
			Line:    item.Location.Line,
			Column:  item.Location.Column,
		})
	}

	return &ValidationResult{Valid: isValid, Errors: errors}, nil
}

// ReactValidator validates React.
type ReactValidator struct {
	baseURL string
}

func (v *ReactValidator) ValidateAll(ctx context.Context, taskID string, files []WorkspaceFile) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	if v.baseURL == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("react validator url is empty")
	}

	reactPath, reactCode, reactLang := pickReactSource(files)
	if reactPath == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid: false,
			Errors: []ValidationError{
				{Code: "NO_REACT_FILE", Message: "No React source file found"},
			},
		}, nil
	}

	reqPayload := map[string]any{
		"language":  reactLang,
		"framework": "react",
		"taskId":    taskID,
		"code":      reactCode,
		"rules":     []any{},
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(reqPayload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, v.baseURL+"/validate", bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("react validator error: status=%d body=%s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	var decoded struct {
		Success bool `json:"success"`
		Errors  []struct {
			Code       string `json:"code"`
			MessageKey string `json:"messageKey"`
			Message    string `json:"message"`
			Location   struct {
				File   string `json:"file"`
				Line   int    `json:"line"`
				Column int    `json:"column"`
			} `json:"location"`
		} `json:"errors"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &decoded); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0, len(decoded.Errors))
	for _, item := range decoded.Errors {
		message := strings.TrimSpace(item.Message)
		if message == "" {
			message = strings.TrimSpace(item.MessageKey)
		}
		if message == "" {
			message = "React validation error"
		}
		code := strings.TrimSpace(item.Code)
		if code == "" {
			code = "REACT_VALIDATION_ERROR"
		}
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    code,
			Message: message,
			File:    item.Location.File,
			Line:    item.Location.Line,
			Column:  item.Location.Column,
		})
	}

	return &ValidationResult{Valid: decoded.Success, Errors: errors}, nil
}

func pickPrimarySource(files []WorkspaceFile) (string, string) {
	extensions := []string{".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx"}
	for _, ext := range extensions {
		for _, file := range files {
			if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(file.Path), ext) {
				return file.Path, file.Content
			}
		}
	}
	return "", ""
}

func pickReactSource(files []WorkspaceFile) (path string, content string, language string) {
	type candidate struct {
		ext  string
		lang string
	}
	ordered := []candidate{
		{ext: ".tsx", lang: "tsx"},
		{ext: ".jsx", lang: "jsx"},
		{ext: ".ts", lang: "ts"},
		{ext: ".js", lang: "js"},
	}
	for _, wanted := range ordered {
		for _, file := range files {
			if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(file.Path), wanted.ext) {
				return file.Path, file.Content, wanted.lang
			}
		}
	}
	return "", "", ""
}
